enabled.description: Enable or disable this carbon-cache instance (uncomment/comment the section)

listen_port.description: Port to listen on for plaintext line-protocol metrics

pickle_port.description: Port to listen on for pickle (binary batched) protocol metrics

destinations.description: List of downstream carbon-cache destinations to forward metrics to (for aggregation or clustering). Format: [{'address': 'host:port'}, ...]

max_queue_size.description: Maximum number of metrics queued in memory per destination before dropping

batch_size.description: Maximum number of metrics sent in a single batch to each destination

use_pickle.description: Use pickle protocol instead of line-protocol for outbound connections

worker_processes.description: Number of worker processes for handling cache writes

data_dir.description: Root directory where Whisper database files are stored

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (debug, info, warning, error, critical)

log_cache_metrics.description: Enable internal metrics about cache performance (e.g., queue size, hit ratio) in statsd format

cache_query.description: Enable serving metrics from cache (instead of only disk) before flush

max_update_interval.description: Maximum metrics per second to accept (throttle incoming load)

flush_interval.description: Seconds between background flushes of cached metrics to disk

max_cache_size.description: Maximum number of metrics to buffer per Whisper file in memory

create_directories.description: Automatically create directories for new metric paths

stale_sla.description: Seconds of inactivity after which a Whisper file is considered stale and new writes are rejected
